title: PlanImportResult
description: What the import drew and what needs a look. message is the one-line receipt: counts, how the scale stands, and how much there is to review. review has one line per thing to look at.

walls.description: Walls after the clean-up. They are drawn merged, as outlines

merged.description: Pieces merged into a collinear neighbour

squared.description: Walls turned onto an axis (within 3 degrees of it)

diagonal.description: Walls left at their own angle

joined.description: Wall ends run to the wall they stop at

gaps_closed.description: Of those, gaps closed: an end that stood more than 100 mm short of a wall, and less than the thicker of the two walls. Each has a line in review.

extended.description: Wall ends run through an opening that sat past them

loose.description: Openings with no wall in reach, once every wall end has been run and joined: left where detected, drawn red, not cut by the bake

uncut.description: Openings the bake will not cut: the loose ones, and those on a block the bake skips

outlines.description: Wall outlines drawn on the wall layer: walls that overlap or touch are merged into one closed outline per connected run. The bake makes one wall solid, one floor and one roof of each. 1 when the walls make one building.

outline_holes.description: Holes those outlines close, each drawn as a loop of its own on the wall layer (forsk:import_kind wall-hole)

wall_pieces.description: Detected wall pieces that went into the outlines

overlaps.description: Outlines that still overlap or touch another, measured on the outlines as drawn. 0 after a clean merge.

free_walls.description: Outlines standing free of the rest as a lone block, each in review. A slender one is a wall run and bakes as a wall on its own; one wider across than a wall (600 mm) reads as a room outline at the bake and is skipped.

blocks_skipped.description: Of free_walls, the blocks wider than a wall: the bake makes no wall solid of them

unlabelled.description: Rooms with no name in the detection: each is labelled Rom, a text on the label layer to edit

outside.description: Rooms the walls do not close around

dropped.description: Walls and rooms left out, each with its reason

review.description: One line per thing to look at

status.description: detected: read off the plan by the source. unconfirmed: nobody measured it. user: set with plan_scale.

factor.description: Scale from the detection's own mm. 1 at import.

display.description: Display mode the picture is drawn in whatever the view's own mode: Rendered. null when that mode was not found, and the image then shows in rendered views only.

replaced.description: Objects of an earlier import deleted first

message.description: Imported 30 walls (41 detected, 11 merged), 7 doors, 12 windows, 11 rooms. Wall cleanup: 41 wall pieces merged into 2 outlines, 3 gaps closed, 0 overlaps left. Scale not detected (assumed 1:100): set it with two points and a known length. Review: 3 rooms without a label, walls open around 8 rooms, 1 wall standing free, 3 wall gaps closed.
